purpose: Research-only three-level access grades with the v1.1 targeted imagery check. NOT read by the app. catalog/map_points/CO.json carries verified | access-verified | pending; never merge this file into the catalog.

levels.verified: managing-agency GIS point for the ramp/launch/take-out within 150 m of the NHDPlus centreline + official page documenting boating access + v1.1 Esri imagery shows the pin at the water or at the ramp head (verdict pass / pass-ramp-head)
levels.access-verified: official source documents boating access at the site, but the coordinate is an area feature or the imagery check did not show a usable launch at the pin (approximate area)
levels.pending: no official coordinate, unresolved permission, or endpoint in another state

imageryVerdicts.pass: pin at the water's edge / launch
imageryVerdicts.pass-ramp-head: pin at the parking/ramp head with a visible route to water within ~40 m; kept verified with a note
imageryVerdicts.flag: location doubtful or sources conflict; grade unchanged, flag shown
imageryVerdicts.downgrade: verified candidate whose pin is not at a usable launch; published as access-verified

limitations: Esri tiles carry no per-tile capture date; channels move, so NHDPlus HR geometry can lag the imagery (e.g. Deerlodge, Pumphouse). The check confirms the marker sits at a plausible launch; it does not prove the site is open today.
